hook_stat.sub: Committed investment in 12 approved semiconductor projects across six states

news_summary: India has approved 12 semiconductor projects across six states with committed investment of more than Rs 1.64 lakh crore, according to a government factsheet released ahead of SEMICON India 2026.
payoff: India's semiconductor programme has crossed the line from announcements to output.
